newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends three cents up to 13.75 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends three cents up to 13.75 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose three cents to 13.75 ringgit ($5.45) a kg after a jump on the London Metal Exchange (LME) last Friday, traders said.

They said the tin price was poised to test the psychological barrier of 13.80 cents a kg by Tuesday if the sellers do not emerge in droves. "I think we can touch 13.80, although much depends on how the LME will perform," said a trader.

Buyers from Europe, Japan and Malaysia took initial positions for 144 tonnes against offers for 101. Final turnover was at 112 tonnes, against the 138 on Friday. The local premium against London narrowed to $50 from $60 previously.
